May 28, 2018 - By Michael Collier
Rfg Advisory Group Llc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 29.94% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Rfg Advisory Group Llc bought 4,437 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 19,258 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $3.33 million, up from 14,821 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Rfg Advisory Group Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $926.90B market cap company. The stock increased 0.23% or $0.43 during the last trading session, reaching $188.58. About 15.45 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 28, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
Pinebridge Investments Lp decreased its stake in Avnet Inc Com (AVT) by 46.14% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Pinebridge Investments Lp sold 14,755 shares as the company’s stock rose 4.09% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund held 17,222 shares of the consumer non-durables company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $682,000, down from 31,977 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Pinebridge Investments Lp who had been investing in Avnet Inc Com for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $4.57 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.13% or $0.05 during the last trading session, reaching $38.7. About 400,314 shares traded. Avnet, Inc. (NYSE:AVT) has declined 6.72% since May 28, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 18.27% the S&P500.
